name: 薄壳晶莹多汁龙眼款
description: 果肉晶莹皮薄肉厚，清甜多汁的新鲜鲜果

styleLock.direction: fresh tropical fruit commerce, orchard-to-table warmth
styleLock.backgroundSystem: clean white #FFFFFF for packshots and trust screens, soft warm oat-beige #F3EFE3 for benefit and info screens, warm natural wood #C9A87C and woven rattan #D8C4A0 for scene shots
styleLock.lightingSystem: bright soft top-front daylight around 5500K with a gentle fill, soft natural contact shadows, light dewy highlight on the skin and a gentle sheen on the flesh, no harsh speculars
styleLock.surfaceSystem: matte white ceramic plate #FFFFFF, warm natural wood tabletop #C9A87C and woven bamboo-rattan mat #D8C4A0
styleLock.typography: modern geometric sans-serif headlines in charcoal-brown #2E2A22, headline 28-48pt, subtitle 16-20pt, labels 10-14pt, one family for the whole set, no decorative, handwritten or retro styles
styleLock.iconSystem: single-weight thin-line circular icon badges and thin arc connector lines in #7BA83E
styleLock.presentationRules: consistent fruit scale and a stable slight 3/4 hero angle across the set; every fruit pile grounded by a contact shadow, never floating; round fruit stacked in a loose natural pile; every frame composed as one complete balanced layout
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent fresh tropical fruit commerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of clean white background #FFFFFF, soft warm oat-beige #F3EFE3, charcoal-brown text #2E2A22 and one fresh green accent #7BA83E; warm tone; bright soft top-front daylight around 5500K with a gentle fill, soft natural contact shadows and dewy highlights on the fruit; modern geometric sans-serif headlines in charcoal-brown #2E2A22, headline 28-48pt, labels 10-14pt, one family across the set; consistent rounded info labels and single-weight thin-line circular icon badges in #7BA83E with thin arc connector lines; surfaces of matte white ceramic #FFFFFF, warm natural wood #C9A87C and woven bamboo-rattan #D8C4A0; clean high-end fresh-produce photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; stable fruit scale and a stable slight 3/4 hero angle; round fruit always stacked in a loose natural pile grounded by a contact shadow; every frame composed as one complete balanced layout with natural breathing margins; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.

shots.intent: 搜索列表一眼点击，白底合规、果肉一眼可见

shots.lighting: bright even high-key studio light, soft front-left key with fill, soft natural contact shadow grounding the fruit
shots.background: seamless pure white #FFFFFF with a matte white ceramic plate #FFFFFF
shots.props: one matte white square ceramic plate
shots.promptTemplate: Product photography of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. A fresh loose pile of whole {product} with three peeled fruits showing translucent pale-gold flesh, resting on a matte white square ceramic plate, photographed at a slight 3/4 angle at eye level with the whole pile filling 60-70% of the frame as one complete clean composition, nothing clipped. Bright even high-key studio lighting with a soft front-left key and fill, a soft natural contact shadow grounding every fruit. Seamless pure white background #FFFFFF. 8K, commercial fresh-produce e-commerce quality. Negative: no props other than the plate, no hands, no watermark, no brand mark, no logo, no extra text, no decorative elements, no cut-off edges, no floating fruit, no plastic-looking or waxy skin, no duplicated fruit in the background.
